reasons: Conflicting constraints: student requires CS4238 and CS4215 in the same semester, but also states they must not be in the same semester.

Prerequisite chain for CS4238 requires CS3235, which requires CS2105, CS2106, and CS2107. CS2106 requires CS2100. CS2100 requires a programming module. With no completed modules, these cannot be taken in Y1S1.
CS4261 requires MA1100/CS1231, MA2001, and an EE/ST/MA math module. CS4268 requires CS3230 and similar math prerequisites. These cannot be satisfied in Y1S1.
